description: Use when an x402 seller or marketplace operator needs an attested on-chain settlement statement for a payee wallet over a bounded period. Ingests Base mainnet USDC Transfer logs, classifies likely x402 settlements, assembles STMT-JCS-1 aggregates and methodology, ML-DSA-65 signs, persists, and anchors the digest. Inputs payee_address (required), period_from and period_to (ISO dates). $3.00 USDC per call.
name: get_x402_seller_statement
title: Get X402 Seller Statement
